SELECT s.Name
FROM shop s
JOIN hiring h ON s.Shop_ID = h.Shop_ID
GROUP BY s.Shop_ID, s.Name
ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT h.Employee_ID) DESC
LIMIT 1;
FINAL SQL:
SELECT s.Name
FROM shop s
JOIN hiring h ON s.Shop_ID = h.Shop_ID
GROUP BY s.Shop_ID, s.Name
ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT h.Employee_ID) DESC
LIMIT 1;
